answers.ONE_LINE_PURPOSE: Grades MCP connectors from A to F from real evidence (known vulnerabilities, known-malicious packages, suspicious code patterns), publishes the full dependency tree, and states what it does not check. Open source so anyone can audit exactly how a grade is produced.
answers.RUN_INSTRUCTIONS: Tests: `make test`. Run: build the image (`podman build -t mcp-connectors-scanner .`) and start it with the compose file. It needs a Postgres database (its own role and database, created by `init-db.sh`), a catalog feed URL and token, and an API token. The scanner executes inside its container only, never on the host.
